space.$description: Spacing scale (padding, gaps, fixed dimensions). Non-linear step scale named by token weight. Derived from the Flowin foundation spacing scale. This weight-named scale is the COMPLETE set and the one component contracts cite; a transform may additionally expose the t-shirt subset in `space.alias` as its ergonomic layout API, but that subset is an alias onto these steps, never a separate scale.

radius.$description: Corner-radius scale. Derived from the Flowin foundation corner-radius scale. `cornerSmoothing` is a unitless smoothing factor (continuous-corner ratio), not a px length; `full` is a sentinel that yields a fully rounded (pill) shape.

border.$description: Border / stroke width scale for CONTAINER edges. Derived from the Flowin foundation border scale. Icon stroke weights are a separate, finer scale — see `stroke.icon`.

stroke.$description: Stroke weights for drawn glyphs, as opposed to the container-edge widths in `border`.

icon.$description: Icon stroke weight, one entry per `size.icon` step. This size↔stroke pairing is a genuinely-Flowin concept with no native slot on a typical platform: it binds into the theme-extension mechanism (DESIGN.md §2) alongside the icon sizes it pairs with. A transform MUST carry the pairing, not just the sizes — an icon rendered at a larger box with an unchanged stroke reads as a different weight of icon.

size.$description: Sizing scales — fixed measures for interactive controls and icons. Distinct from the spacing scale: a control height or icon box is a sizing decision, not a spacing value.

icon.$description: Icon box sizes. Each step is paired with a stroke weight in `stroke.icon` so icon thickness scales with the box; the two are one contract and must be transformed together. Default step is `md`.
